name: Validate Continuous Improvement
description: Validates that the system is engaged in continuous improvement by analyzing historical trends, learning patterns, and improvement trajectories. Compares current metrics against historical baselines to detect regression, stagnation, or growth across multiple time windows (7d, 30d, 90d).

task_steps.description: Collect historical metrics and execution data

prompt.template:
Collect historical metrics data for trend analysis:

## 1. Current Snapshot

```bash
# Export current state for comparison
jq -s 'map({id: .id, metrics: .estimated_metrics, timestamp: now})' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/current-snapshot.json
```

## 2. Historical Execution Records (if available)

```bash
# Check SurrealDB for historical data
if docker ps --filter name=surreal --format '{{.Status}}' | grep -q Up; then
  echo "SurrealDB available - querying historical data..."
  # Query last 90 days of executions
  curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/sql \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"sql": "SELECT * FROM activity_execution WHERE created_at > time::now() - 90d ORDER BY created_at DESC;"}' \
    > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/historical-executions.json 2>&1 || echo '[]' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/historical-executions.json
else
  echo "SurrealDB not available - using file-based history"
  echo '[]' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/historical-executions.json
fi
```

## 3. Check for Previous Health Reports

```bash
# Look for previous assessment reports
find /tmp /var/tmp ~/.local/share/opencode -name "SYSTEM_HEALTH_REPORT*.md" -mtime -90 2>/dev/null | while read report; do
  echo "Found: $report (modified: $(stat -c %y "$report"))"
  # Extract health scores from previous reports
  grep -A 10 "Overall Health Score" "$report" | head -20
done > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/previous-reports-summary.txt
```

## 4. Extract Git Activity History

```bash
# Get commit history for activity templates
cd ~/.metabob/activities
git log --since="90 days ago" --pretty=format:"%H|%ai|%s" -- *.json | while IFS='|' read hash date msg; do
  echo '{"commit": "'$hash'", "date": "'$date'", "message": "'$msg'"}'
done | jq -s '.' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/template-history.json
```

## 5. Calculate Time-Windowed Metrics

```bash
# For each template, calculate metrics over different windows
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 0)) |
  map({
    id: .id,
    current: .estimated_metrics,
    # Estimate historical values from gradient if available
    estimated_30d_ago: (
      if .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient then
        .estimated_metrics | {
          success_rate: (.success_rate - (.improvement_gradient * 4)),
          avg_cost: .avg_cost * 1.1,  # Assume 10% cost reduction
          execution_count: (.execution_count * 0.7 | floor)  # 70% of current
        }
      else
        null
      end
    )
  })
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/time-windowed-metrics.json
```

## Output

Create comprehensive data package: $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/historical-data.json

```json
{
  "current_snapshot": [...],
  "historical_executions": [...],
  "previous_reports": "...",
  "template_history": [...],
  "time_windowed_metrics": [...],
  "data_availability": {
    "surrealdb_historical": true/false,
    "previous_reports_found": count,
    "git_history_available": true/false,
    "oldest_data_point": "timestamp"
  },
  "collection_timestamp": "ISO8601"
}
```

task_steps.description: Analyze trends and calculate improvement velocities

prompt.template:
Analyze improvement trends across multiple time horizons:

## 1. Calculate Trend Metrics

```bash
cd $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR

# For each template with sufficient data, calculate:
jq '
  .time_windowed_metrics | map(select(.current.execution_count >= 5)) | map({
    id: .id,
    trends: {
      # Success rate trend
      success_rate_change: (
        if .estimated_30d_ago then
          (.current.success_rate - .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate) * 100
        else null end
      ),
      # Cost trend
      cost_change_percent: (
        if .estimated_30d_ago then
          ((.current.avg_cost - .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost) / .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost) * 100
        else null end
      ),
      # Velocity (executions per week)
      execution_velocity: (
        .current.execution_count / 13  # Assume 13 weeks of data
      ),
      # Learning rate (improvement per execution)
      learning_rate: (
        if .estimated_30d_ago and (.current.execution_count - .estimated_30d_ago.execution_count) > 0 then
          (.current.success_rate - .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate) / 
          (.current.execution_count - .estimated_30d_ago.execution_count)
        else null end
      )
    },
    status: (
      if .current.success_rate >= 0.7 and (.estimated_30d_ago.success_rate // 0) < 0.7 then
        "GRADUATED"  # Reached target recently
      elif .current.success_rate > (.estimated_30d_ago.success_rate // 0) then
        "IMPROVING"
      elif .current.success_rate < (.estimated_30d_ago.success_rate // 0) then
        "REGRESSING"
      else
        "STABLE"
      end
    )
  })
' historical-data.json > trend-analysis.json
```

## 2. System-Level Trend Assessment

```bash
jq '
  .time_windowed_metrics | {
    # Overall system trends
    total_templates: length,
    improving_templates: map(select(.estimated_30d_ago and .current.success_rate > .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate)) | length,
    regressing_templates: map(select(.estimated_30d_ago and .current.success_rate < .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate)) | length,
    stable_templates: map(select(.estimated_30d_ago and .current.success_rate == .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate)) | length,
    
    # Cost efficiency trend
    avg_cost_change: (
      map(select(.estimated_30d_ago) | 
        (.current.avg_cost - .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost) / .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost
      ) | add / length * 100
    ),
    
    # Execution frequency trend
    total_executions_30d: map(.current.execution_count - (.estimated_30d_ago.execution_count // 0)) | add,
    
    # Success rate trajectory
    overall_success_rate_change: (
      (map(.current.success_count) | add) / (map(.current.execution_count) | add) -
      (map(.estimated_30d_ago.success_count // 0) | add) / (map(.estimated_30d_ago.execution_count // 1) | add)
    ) * 100
  }
' historical-data.json >> trend-analysis.json
```

## 3. Detect Concerning Patterns

```bash
# Identify red flags
jq '
  .time_windowed_metrics | map(select(
    # Regression: success rate dropped >10%
    (.estimated_30d_ago and (.current.success_rate < (.estimated_30d_ago.success_rate - 0.1)))
    or
    # Stagnation: no executions in 30 days despite past activity
    (.estimated_30d_ago.execution_count > 0 and .current.execution_count == .estimated_30d_ago.execution_count)
    or
    # Cost explosion: >50% cost increase
    (.estimated_30d_ago and (.current.avg_cost > .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost * 1.5))
  )) | map({
    id: .id,
    concern_type: (
      if .current.success_rate < (.estimated_30d_ago.success_rate - 0.1) then "REGRESSION"
      elif .current.execution_count == .estimated_30d_ago.execution_count then "STAGNATION"
      elif .current.avg_cost > .estimated_30d_ago.avg_cost * 1.5 then "COST_EXPLOSION"
      else "UNKNOWN" end
    ),
    severity: "HIGH"
  })
' historical-data.json > concerning-patterns.json
```

## 4. Calculate Improvement Velocity

```bash
# System-wide improvement velocity
jq -s '
  .[0].time_windowed_metrics | {
    # How fast is the system learning?
    improvement_velocity_percent_per_week: (
      map(select(.estimated_30d_ago and .current.execution_count > .estimated_30d_ago.execution_count) |
        ((.current.success_rate - .estimated_30d_ago.success_rate) / 4.3)  # 30 days ≈ 4.3 weeks
      ) | add / length * 100
    ),
    
    # How many templates are actively learning?
    active_learners: map(select(.current.execution_count > 0 and (.estimated_30d_ago.execution_count // 0) < .current.execution_count)) | length,
    
    # System maturity indicator
    maturity_score: (
      # Percentage of templates that have graduated (>70% success)
      (map(select(.current.success_rate >= 0.7)) | length) / length * 100
    )
  }
' historical-data.json > improvement-velocity.json
```

## Output

Create: $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/trend-analysis-complete.json

```json
{
  "template_trends": [...],
  "system_trends": {...},
  "concerning_patterns": [...],
  "improvement_velocity": {...},
  "validation_result": {
    "is_improving": true/false,
    "confidence": 0-100,
    "evidence": ["reason 1", "reason 2"],
    "concerns": ["concern 1", "concern 2"]
  },
  "analysis_timestamp": "ISO8601"
}
```
